confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rely on aggregator estimates (Expatistan, Jobicy, Travelsafe-abroad, Oysterlist, Expat Exchange) and a national Numbeo-based cappuccino average, several of them undated or from 2023-2025, so treat them as planning ranges. Beer and cocktail are partly inferred from limited Querétaro and Mexico menu data. No direct local glass-of-wine price was found; wine_glass is set at about 2.3x the beer anchor, using the beer relationship as the basis. Peso conversions assume roughly 17-18 MXN per USD. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Querétaro hotel tiers; no accommodation search or live listing was checked. FX: the 0.6720 value for 2026-11-18 came from a third-party aggregator (ozfinancehub) that cites RBA data, and it is consistent with market quotes of about 0.6715 that day. I could not open the official rba.gov.au table to confirm that value, so the source_url is the official RBA page but the rate is not verified against it. The 19 November 2026 observation was not found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Restaurant anchors are based on Mexican national aggregates and Querétaro-area aggregator data points, with adjustment for a mid-sized city with a tourist and expat presence. Drink anchors draw on Mexican downtown cocktail data points (for example Chapala-Ajijic and Tapachula) and the national cappuccino average. Accommodation tiers are holistic model estimates.
